cw-contains-else-return:
assert contains([7, 3, 9], 9) is True
assert contains([7, 3, 9], 4) is False
assert contains([], 4) is False
cw-count-even:
assert count_even([1, 2, 3, 4]) == 2
assert count_even([]) == 0
assert count_even([5, 7]) == 0
assert count_even([0, -2]) == 2
cw-doubled-new-list:
a = [1, 2, 3]
assert doubled(a) == [2, 4, 6]
assert a == [1, 2, 3]
assert doubled([]) == []
cw-add-item-in-place:
assert shopping == ["milk", "eggs"]
b = []
add_item(b, 1)
assert b == [1]
cw-power-base-case:
assert power(2, 3) == 8
assert power(5, 1) == 5
assert power(7, 0) == 1
cw-digit-sum:
assert digit_sum(472) == 13
assert digit_sum(0) == 0
assert digit_sum(9) == 9
assert digit_sum(1005) == 6
cw-repeat-string:
assert repeat("ab", 3) == "ababab"
assert repeat("x", 0) == ""
assert repeat("", 4) == ""
fill-factorial-base-case:
assert factorial(0) == 1
assert factorial(1) == 1
assert factorial(5) == 120
fill-sum-recursive-step:
assert total(0) == 0
assert total(1) == 1
assert total(4) == 10
cw-biggest-base-zero:
assert biggest([3, 9, 4]) == 9
assert biggest([5]) == 5
assert biggest([-3, -7]) == -3
cw-contains-index:
assert contains([4, 8, 1], 1, 0) is True
assert contains([4, 8, 1], 4, 0) is True
assert contains([4, 8, 1], 5, 0) is False
assert contains([], 5, 0) is False
cw-count-vowels:
assert vowels("banana") == 3
assert vowels("") == 0
assert vowels("xyz") == 0
assert vowels("aei") == 3
fill-reverse-step:
assert rev("abc") == "cba"
assert rev("") == ""
assert rev("x") == "x"
cw-build-list-up:
assert build(3) == [1, 2, 3]
assert build(0) == []
assert build(1) == [1]
cw-fib-one-base-case:
assert fib(1) == 1
assert fib(2) == 1
assert fib(6) == 8
assert fib(0) == 0
cw-maze-no-visited:
m = [list("S.#"), list("#.#"), list("#.E")]
assert solve(m, 0, 0) is True
m = [list("S.#"), list("##E")]
assert solve(m, 0, 0) is False
m = [list("S...."), list(".###."), list("....E")]
assert solve(m, 0, 0) is True
m = [list("SE")]
assert solve(m, 0, 0) is True
